variants.name: Chicken & Salmon 85 g
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Fish and fish derivatives 26% (salmon 16%), meat and animal derivatives 16% (fresh chicken 4%), oils and fats, minerals, various sugars.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 10.0%, crude fibre 0.3%, crude fat 5.5%, crude ash 2.7%, moisture 79%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin D3 245 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha- tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 15 mg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.05 mg) 0.02 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 11.5 mg) 3.75 mg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 21.8 mg) 17.5 mg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 5.88 mg) 1.5 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 38 mg) 12.5 mg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.3 mg) 0.2 mg, Taurine 500 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes for adult cats (see table) may be split into 2 meals. Make sure fresh and clean water is always available. When this product replaces another type, it is advisable to introduce it gradually over a period of at least 1 week. Cat food not suitable for human consumption. Store in a cool, dry place. After opening, store in the fridge and use within 2 days.
